info.title: Hagency owner Agent API
info.description: Current implemented HTTP contract (protocol v2; route prefix remains v1). Native clients only: exactly one matching public Host; no Origin, Cookie, X-Forwarded-Host or duplicate Authorization. User-session and device bearers are different capabilities. All /api/hagency/v1 responses use Cache-Control: no-store; JSON requests ≤131072 bytes. Model/provider secrets and local allocation/tool policy never belong here. Global permanent-owner Agent identity is independent of Project/Room; one designated stable owner device executes each Agent. Project=adopted Matrix Space; Room membership stays independent. No Fleet/Engagement compatibility, import or Agent transfer. Errors use {code}; unsupported operations are 400, not an assumed 404. This spec excludes Palpo/Pasion/Matrix APIs, browser same-origin proxy and owner-local console APIs. Newly allocated Hagency entity IDs use a type prefix plus a 26-character lowercase ULID. IDs remain opaque to clients; authorization tokens are separate 256-bit random values. Matrix room/event IDs and immutable transaction identities are not generated by this scheme.

Requires current assigned owner device, live original lease/epoch, binding generation and fresh Matrix permissions. Room, target event, puppet, key and content are never caller arguments. Repeated same attempt returns one immutable durable receipt; an already completed attempt can return its existing receipt but cannot create a new intent. SessionGrant.description: Opaque Hagency user-session bearer, not upstream Pasion access token. Finite validUntilMs; initial authorization proof capped to 30000 ms. Never expose to model.

DeviceGrant.description: Device-only bearer attached to owner/session/installation and generation. Same installation rotates token and fences old generation. Validity follows session; revoke/signout invalidates execution rights.

Agent.description: Creator ownerUserId is permanent. No transfer operation or owner update exists. Retirement is lifecycle state, not identity reassignment.

ownerServicePaused.description: True only when this binding was explicitly paused by its owner. Membership or administrator suspension is not an owner pause.

threadAutoReply.description: Owner opt-in per project binding: authorized members may follow up without another mention in an already activated thread. Default false requires a canonical mention for every project Room message. Owner-direct chat is unaffected.

CreationPolicy.description: Deny wins. Project permission AND Room permission AND fresh Matrix membership are required; Room allow-list cannot override Project deny.

threadRoot.description: Immutable logical conversation key: exact Room ID for new top-level owner-direct requests; Matrix event ID for explicit threads and Project requests. Historical event-root intents retain their threaded reply shape.

body.description: Nonempty UTF-8 text, default maximum 65536 bytes (byte count, not Unicode codepoints); request JSON limit also applies.

threadRoot.description: Immutable logical conversation key: exact Room ID for new top-level owner-direct requests; Matrix event ID for explicit threads and Project requests. Historical event-root intents retain their threaded reply shape.

ReplyIntent.description: Durable outbox receipt. pending/sending/unknown does not prove Matrix delivery. Only sent plus matrixEventId proves delivery. dispatchEpoch retains original execution epoch; deliveryEpoch is current authorized sending epoch. workerToken is private and never serialized.

RoomCreationPolicy.description: Tagged snake_case Rust enum. inherit_project can further deny; allow_list restricts the Project permission; disabled denies all.

revision.description: Creation-policy revision for the selected Project or Room, required as expectedRevision for policy writes.

canManagePolicy.description: Read-only UI hint from current Matrix membership and power levels for this exact scope. Every write rechecks authority.

creationPolicy.description: JSON-encoded Project or Room creation policy, read in the same database transaction as revision.

ExecutionHistorySnapshot.description: Opaque immutable started-execution count and SHA256 witness. Hash input is domain separator hagency-started-executions-v1 plus newline, followed by each C-collation ordered JSON [dispatchId,executionId] plus newline. Outcomes and current lease do not change this witness.
